summary.text: Tom Young, Jr. is a Republican state senator from Aiken representing District 24 in Aiken County, and an attorney and business owner. He chairs the Senate Family and Veterans' Services Committee and previously served in the S.C. House of Representatives from 2009 to 2012.

paragraphs.text: Young was born on October 8, 1971, in Aiken, according to his legislative biography.
He earned a B.A. in 1993 and a J.D. in 1996 from the University of South Carolina, where he was student body president in 1992-93, a Carolina Scholar in 1989, and a Phi Beta Kappa member.
His biography lists committee assignments in Agriculture and Natural Resources, Education, Family and Veterans' Services (chairman), Finance, Fish, Game and Forestry, and Legislative Oversight.
He is a member of St. John's Methodist Church.
